_comment: The published scores the airline ratings in carriers.json are computed from (concorde-travel/rate_airlines.py). Gathered 2026-09-24 by research agents from the publishers' own pages, every figure re-checked against its source by a second agent; none needed a numeric correction. Skytrax economy stars by haul come from skytraxratings.com (a separate read and check); many of those pages were last updated in 2020-2022. Refresh when AirHelp, ACSI or J.D. Power publish a new edition. Per-cabin Skytrax stars (skytrax_cabins) and the 2026 World Airline Awards cabin rankings (awards) were added the same day, read by one agent and checked by another; neither needed a correction.

Short- and medium-haul A320 flights sell food and drinks from the Onboard Bar and stream to your own device. The Ocean Blue A330 refit, with 4K screens and Wi-Fi, starts in spring 2027.

Free Starlink Wi-Fi for MileagePlus members is so far on 300+ United Express regional jets. The rest of the gap is the free meal on long-haul (a borderline 'same').
